mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM api_client c JOIN api_client_permission cp ON cp.client_id=c.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=cp.permission_id AND p.permission_key='machine.ingest.submit' AND p.status='active' JOIN api_client_scope s ON s.client_id=c.id AND s.scope_type='data_source' AND s.scope_id=CAST(#{sourceId} AS CHAR) JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id=CAST(s.scope_id AS UNSIGNED) AND ds.status='active' WHERE c.id=#{clientId} AND c.client_type='connector' AND c.status='active' AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_mapping sm JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id=sm.data_source_id AND ds.status='active' WHERE sm.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND sm.mapping_version=#{mappingVersion} AND sm.status='approved')

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM api_client_scope s JOIN asset a ON a.id=CAST(s.scope_id AS UNSIGNED) AND a.status='active' JOIN api_client_source_asset_scope pair ON pair.client_id=s.client_id AND pair.asset_id=a.id AND pair.data_source_id=#{sourceId} WHERE s.client_id=#{clientId} AND s.scope_type='asset' AND s.scope_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR))

SELECT id,batch_key,data_source_id,status,total_count,accepted_count,rejected_count,request_sha256,COALESCE(sequence_gap,0) sequence_gap FROM ingest_batch WHERE data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT id FROM ingest_batch WHERE batch_key=#{batchKey}
SELECT MAX(sequence_no) FROM ingest_batch WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND config_version=#{configVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE sensor_agent SET last_heartbeat_at=#{observedAt},agent_version=#{agentVersion},capabilities_json=#{capabilities} WHERE id=#{sensorId} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT config_version,interface_scope_json,filter_policy_json,flow_window_seconds,feature_contract_version,sampling_policy_json,activated_at FROM sensor_config WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND status='active' ORDER BY activated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sensor_health_window WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND window_start<#{windowEnd} AND window_end>#{windowStart})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sensor_config WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND config_version=#{configVersion} AND feature_contract_version=#{contractVersion} AND status='active')

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_mapping sm JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id=sm.data_source_id AND ds.status='active' WHERE sm.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND sm.mapping_version=#{mappingVersion} AND sm.status='approved')

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_client c JOIN api_client_permission cp ON cp.client_id=c.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=cp.permission_id AND p.permission_key='machine.sensor.ingest' AND p.status='active' JOIN api_client_source_asset_scope pair ON pair.client_id=c.id AND pair.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND pair.asset_id=#{assetId} JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id=pair.data_source_id AND ds.status='active' JOIN asset a ON a.id=pair.asset_id AND a.status='active' WHERE c.id=#{clientId} AND c.client_type='sensor' AND c.status='active')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_authorization WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND status='active' AND valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
SELECT sa.id,sa.asset_id,sa.status FROM sensor_agent sa JOIN api_client c ON c.sensor_id=sa.id WHERE sa.id=#{sensorId} AND c.id=#{clientId} AND c.client_type='sensor'
SELECT id FROM sensor_agent WHERE id=#{sensorId} AND status='active' FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_client WHERE id=#{clientId} AND sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND client_type='sensor')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_client_permission cp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=cp.permission_id WHERE cp.client_id=#{clientId} AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND p.status='active')

SELECT id,batch_key,data_source_id,status,total_count,accepted_count,rejected_count,request_sha256,COALESCE(sequence_gap,0) sequence_gap FROM ingest_batch WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND config_version=#{configVersion} AND sequence_no=#{sequence}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_source WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND status='active')
SELECT id FROM sensor_agent WHERE agent_key=#{agentKey}
SELECT id FROM api_client WHERE client_key=#{clientKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE sensor_agent SET credential_ref=#{credentialRef} WHERE id=#{sensorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_client_permission (client_id,permission_id) SELECT #{clientId},id FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_key IN ('machine.sensor.heartbeat','machine.sensor.config.read','machine.sensor.ingest')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.permission_key='sensor.manage' AND p.status='active' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ((ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*') OR (ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR))))

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset a JOIN asset_authorization aa ON aa.asset_id=a.id AND aa.status='active' AND aa.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND aa.valid_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE a.id=#{assetId} AND a.status='active')

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.permission_key='sensor.manage' AND p.status='active' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ((ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*') OR (ur.scope_type='data_source' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{sourceId} AS CHAR))))

SELECT id,event_key,topic,payload_json,attempts FROM outbox_event WHERE status IN ('pending','failed') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT r.id, r.batch_id, b.data_source_id, r.source_record_key, r.event_time, r.asset_id, r.normalized_payload FROM ingest_record r JOIN ingest_batch b ON b.id=r.batch_id WHERE r.batch_id=#{batchId} AND r.quality_status='accepted' ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id, consumer, message_key, status, attempts, last_error_code, last_error_message, consumed_at FROM consumed_message WHERE consumer=#{consumer} AND message_key=#{messageKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consumed_message (consumer, message_key, status, attempts, updated_at) VALUES (#{consumer}, #{messageKey}, 'processing', 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE consumed_message SET status='processing', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer=#{consumer} AND message_key=#{messageKey} AND status <> 'consumed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consumed_message (consumer, message_key, status, attempts, last_error_code, last_error_message, updated_at) VALUES (#{consumer}, #{messageKey}, #{status}, 1, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
